name: Jinn Merchant Operating Layer
purpose: Help participating businesses run sales, payments, loyalty, invoicing, supplier payments, receipts and growth from one operating layer.

features.name: Configurable split payouts and revenue waterfalls
Tips and gratuities with transparent allocation
QR/NFC payment and HoloMenu entry points
Cross-border pricing, currency and compliance hooks
Procurement/RFP payment readiness and contract invoicing

guardrails: Do not claim TryAMM has no tax responsibility globally; determine seller/marketplace role per jurisdiction.
Do not commingle merchant payable, tax liabilities and TryAMM revenue.
Do not auto-submit loan, grant or procurement applications without merchant approval.
Do not expose full payment credentials or sensitive tax documents in general app surfaces.
Paid placement and financing offers must be clearly disclosed.
